task.title: [Bug]: Sensor throws multiple errors every second when trying to get Docker stats on AWS Fargate
task.body: ### Problem Description I have recently added the go-sensor to a Golang application that is run on AWS Fargate. While it is logging _some_ metrics to Instana, multiple times per second it is raising a warning for `instana: WARN: failed to retrieve Docker container stats: malformed task stats response: unexpected block i/o op "Sync"` I have followed the Instana instructions for Fargate and I cannot for life of me figure out what's wrong here. ### Instana Customer Name IBM (Hashicorp) ### Minimal, Complete, Verifiable, Example Add the environment variables for `INSTANA_AGENT_KEY` and `INSTANA_ENDPOINT_URL` In my main.go ```go opts := instana.DefaultOptions() opts.LogLevel = instana.Debug instana.StartMetrics(opts) ``` Deploy to AWS Fargate. (We have logs directed to CloudWatch so we can see what's going on, and you can observe in the container logs ### Go Version go1.24.1 ### go.mod partial ```shell github.com/instana/go-sensor v1.73.2 // indirect ``` ### go env ```shell I cannot. It's running in an AWS Fargate container. ```
